label: Kills: causal initiation versus a new threat
resolution: KILLS_1 counts any causal path from the intervention to the one's harm, so diverting the trolley kills. KILLS_2 counts only a path that avoids the redirection of the existing threat, so diverting does not kill but pushing and harvesting do. The causal no-killing deontology uses KILLS_1; the redirection principle uses KILLS_2. No argument passes between them; the controls certify that the switch separates them.
